item.title: Salsa Thursdays at Time Out Market — Thu Jul 23, 7:00 PM — Time Out Market New York
item.description:
Join us for one of NYC’s best free salsa nights and turn your Thursday into a dance-floor celebration.
Get your salsa on every Thursday night at Time Out Market New York! Head up to the fifth floor for an electrifying evening of rhythm, movement, and Latin vibes. Whether you’re a total beginner or a seasoned dancer, this is your weekly excuse to move, sweat, and smile. Starting at 7:30 PM, renowned instructor Marlene Veras will guide you through the steps, breaking down the fundamentals so you feel confident on the dance floor. The night is powered by infectious beats from DJ Ray Suave, with live percussion by Jessica La Timbalera, setting the stage for a high-energy salsa experience. After the lesson, the floor opens up for a full-on salsa dance party until 10 PM. Bring a partner or come solo—everyone’s welcome.

item.title: Microsoft IQ Deep Dive with Python: Fabric IQ — Thu Jul 30, 1:00 PM
item.description:
Microsoft Reactor Toronto In the final session of our Microsoft IQ Deep Dive with Python series, we’ll explore Fabric IQ and how it connects AI experiences to structured business data.
We’ll introduce the key concepts behind Fabric IQ, including ontologies and data agents, and show how they help describe, organize, and reason over operational data stored in OneLake.
We’ll use the Microsoft Fabric API SDK in Python to connect to Fabric IQ, so that we can programmatically configure ontologies and answer questions about our data.
All code demos will use Python and will be available in an open-source repository for you to deploy yourself.
After the stream, join office hours in the [Microsoft Foundry Discord](http://aka.ms/aipython/oh) to ask follow-up questions.
Source: Meetup: Microsoft Reactor Toronto

item.description:

### Island Paths, Skyline Views & Toronto's Best Urban Escape
There is something magical about the Toronto Islands. Just minutes from downtown, the noise of the city disappears and is replaced by tree-lined paths, open green spaces, quiet cottages, and some of the best skyline views anywhere in Toronto. It feels like you've escaped the city without ever leaving it.
Join us for a relaxed summer walk across the Toronto Islands as we explore **Hanlan's Point, Centre Island, and Ward's Island**, enjoying beautiful scenery, fresh air, and great conversation along the way.
The Toronto Islands have a fascinating history. Originally connected to the mainland as a long sandbar peninsula, a powerful storm in 1858 permanently separated the land from Toronto, creating the islands we know today.
